name: DataSelf MCP+
description:
DataSelf MCP+ connects AI assistants to your DataSelf SQL Server data warehouse, enabling users to explore business data and KPIs using natural language—without writing SQL or Python.

Unlike a basic database connector, DataSelf MCP+ provides access to curated, governed, business-friendly models that consolidate data from multiple operational systems. Rich metadata supplies essential business context, while purpose-built star and galaxy schemas, optimized indexing, and efficient table relationships accelerate queries and reduce unnecessary data retrieval, processing, and AI-token usage. This shared foundation delivers consistent, trustworthy answers across AI assistants—including Claude, Copilot, Gemini, and ChatGPT—and analytics platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, and Excel.

Users authenticate through Microsoft OAuth 2.0, with access limited to their authorized DataSelf entities and data.

Capabilities

Confirm the authenticated user
List accessible companies, divisions, and data warehouses
Discover available tables, views, schemas, and models
Retrieve table and field metadata
Run read-only SQL SELECT queries and return results
Reject writes, DDL, and multi-statement requests

_published_faq.name: How do I add DataSelf MCP+ to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add DataSelf MCP+ to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.dataself.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the DataSelf MCP+ MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: DataSelf MCP+ provides these MCP tools: describe_table, list_entities, list_tables, run_query, and whoami.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to DataSelf MCP+?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to DataSelf MCP+ in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does DataSelf MCP+ MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: DataSelf MCP+ requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
DataSelf MCP+ is developed by DataSelf Corp. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
